source: Eight REST pages covering open and closed issues; #716 and PRs excluded

new_records.title: [Bug] Python AST & Linker — Module-level functional type factories (NewType, namedtuple, functional Enum & TypedDict) are dropped from symbol index, severing cross-file symbol edges
[Bug] Business Workflow Map — Dual-protocol exception workflow omits WebSocket handler (ExceptionMiddleware.websocket_exception) despite explicit title and summary promise
[Bug] Ruby require_relative fails to resolve valid nested file dependencies
[Bug] Business Workflow Map — Config workflow omits Config.from_object() although its own title promises object-based loading
[Bug] Python Linker / Connected Code Map — Global symbol index overwrites subpackage symbols across monorepo roots, cross-wiring active imports and selections.jsonl to legacy files
[Bug] Flawed k-hop BFS traversal, duplicate vertex mutations, and label state collision in Connected Code Map (connected-code.html)
[Bug] Business Risk Findings — silently absent from a COMPLETE review with no user-facing disclosure (risk_findings: DISABLED_BY_SERVER_POLICY)
[Bug] archive.source_files() — `.env` virtualenv directory silently ingested as source code
[Bug] Python Linker — Submodule imports via 'from <pkg> import <submodule>' and explicit '__init__.py' re-exports fail symbol resolution, severing cross-module edges
[Bug] Upload archiver (archive.py) — a small project is refused as "too big" because .env/ and .mypy_cache/ are counted, even though the engine ignores those folders
[Challenge 2026][Cohort 3][Track 1] [Bug] CLI recovery handler — unconditional resume advice creates self-referential error loops on terminal failures
[Bug] Source archive — unreadable source directories are silently omitted from uploads
[Bug] JavaScript/TypeScript resolver — internal JSON module imports are silently dropped because .json files are excluded from workspace scanning
[Bug] html-report/workflows — Workflow Area badge count mismatch when rendering single-workflow areas on Python codebases

conclusion: No matching typed method-value extraction mechanism identified. This current MySQL extension strengthens existing #716 rather than proposing a new issue. Historical comment checks retain their original scope/time.
